question.question:
A fictional digital savings account opens on day 1 of month one with 11300 USD. Month one has 31 days; month two has 28 days. Daily interest is the balance at the beginning of that day times the annual rate in effect, as a ratio, divided by 365. Interest is credited only at the end of the last day of each month and earns interest from the next month. A promotional annual rate of 3 percent applies for the account's first 50 days (opening day is day 1, counted across the month boundary); afterwards the standard annual rate of 1 percent applies. A deposit of 4750 USD arrives at the beginning of day 21 of month two and earns interest from that day. What is the closing balance in USD at the end of month two after month-two interest is credited?

Answer format: use exact arithmetic through all intermediate steps, round only the final value half up to 2 decimal digits, and return only the numeric value interpreted in `usd` with no unit label or additional text.
